files.README.md:
# Skelford Energy - turbine office

Full load shaft speeds are recorded from the tachograph in revolutions a minute.
The protection relay at each set takes its overspeed setting in hertz.

turns.prompt: Skelford Energy is setting the overspeed trip on the turbine at Skelford Two. The set runs at 3,450 revolutions a minute at full load, and the relay counts sixty revolutions a minute to the hertz. What hertz setting goes on the relay? Give the answer as a single number, with no unit in the reply. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
